cards.back:
The state of being healthy, happy and comfortable.
Bahasa Indonesia: kesejahteraan
Example: Time with friends is good for your wellbeing.
cards.say: wellbeing. The state of being healthy, happy and comfortable. Time with friends is good for your wellbeing.

cards.back:
The condition of your thoughts and feelings.
Bahasa Indonesia: kesehatan mental
Example: Talking about worries is good for your mental health.
cards.say: mental health. The condition of your thoughts and feelings. Talking about worries is good for your mental health.

cards.back:
A feeling of worry and pressure that makes you tense.
Bahasa Indonesia: stres
Example: Exams can cause stress, so take deep breaths and rest.
cards.say: stress. A feeling of worry and pressure that makes you tense. Exams can cause stress, so take deep breaths and rest.

cards.back:
Paying calm attention to what is happening right now.
Bahasa Indonesia: penuh kesadaran
Example: Be mindful as you listen to the rain, and notice every sound.
cards.say: mindful. Paying calm attention to what is happening right now. Be mindful as you listen to the rain, and notice every sound.

cards.back:
Full of the substances your body needs.
Bahasa Indonesia: kaya gizi
Example: Spinach and beans are nutrient-rich foods for growing children.
cards.say: nutrient-rich. Full of the substances your body needs. Spinach and beans are nutrient-rich foods for growing children.

cards.back:
Spending much time sitting down and not moving.
Bahasa Indonesia: kurang gerak
Example: A sedentary day on the sofa is bad for your heart.
cards.say: sedentary. Spending much time sitting down and not moving. A sedentary day on the sofa is bad for your heart.

cards.back:
The ability to keep going for a long time.
Bahasa Indonesia: daya tahan
Example: Long swims build endurance in your lungs and legs.
cards.say: endurance. The ability to keep going for a long time. Long swims build endurance in your lungs and legs.

cards.back:
The ability to bend and stretch easily.
Bahasa Indonesia: kelenturan
Example: Gymnasts practise daily to improve their flexibility and their balance.
cards.say: flexibility. The ability to bend and stretch easily. Gymnasts practise daily to improve their flexibility and their balance.

cards.back:
A doctor's decision about what illness a person has.
Bahasa Indonesia: diagnosis
Example: The doctor gave a clear diagnosis and explained the treatment.
cards.say: diagnosis. A doctor's decision about what illness a person has. The doctor gave a clear diagnosis and explained the treatment.

cards.back:
Care given to a sick or injured person.
Bahasa Indonesia: pengobatan, perawatan
Example: Treatment for a broken arm includes a hard cast for weeks.
cards.say: treatment. Care given to a sick or injured person. Treatment for a broken arm includes a hard cast for weeks.

cards.back:
Able to be passed from one person to another.
Bahasa Indonesia: menular
Example: The flu is contagious, so stay home if you are ill.
cards.say: contagious. Able to be passed from one person to another. The flu is contagious, so stay home if you are ill.

cards.back:
A disease that spreads quickly to many people.
Bahasa Indonesia: wabah
Example: The town acted fast to stop the epidemic from spreading.
cards.say: epidemic. A disease that spreads quickly to many people. The town acted fast to stop the epidemic from spreading.

cards.back:
Keeping someone apart from others to stop a disease spreading.
Bahasa Indonesia: karantina
Example: Travellers stayed in quarantine for a week to protect the village.
cards.say: quarantine. Keeping someone apart from others to stop a disease spreading. Travellers stayed in quarantine for a week to protect the village.

cards.back:
A medicine that kills harmful bacteria or stops them from growing.
Bahasa Indonesia: antibiotik
Example: The doctor prescribed an antibiotic for the throat infection.
cards.say: antibiotic. A medicine that kills harmful bacteria or stops them from growing. The doctor prescribed an antibiotic for the throat infection.

cards.back:
Tiny living things, some of which cause disease.
Bahasa Indonesia: bakteri
Example: Washing hands removes bacteria that can make you ill.
cards.say: bacteria. Tiny living things, some of which cause disease. Washing hands removes bacteria that can make you ill.

cards.back:
Having enough water in your body.
Bahasa Indonesia: hidrasi, cukup cairan
Example: Good hydration keeps you alert during long school days.
cards.say: hydration. Having enough water in your body. Good hydration keeps you alert during long school days.

cards.back:
A nutrient in food that helps your body grow and repair.
Bahasa Indonesia: protein
Example: Eggs, fish and beans are good sources of protein.
cards.say: protein. A nutrient in food that helps your body grow and repair. Eggs, fish and beans are good sources of protein.

cards.back:
A part of plant food that helps your digestion.
Bahasa Indonesia: serat
Example: Wholegrain bread and fruit are full of fibre.
cards.say: fibre. A part of plant food that helps your digestion. Wholegrain bread and fruit are full of fibre.

cards.back:
A quick movement your body makes without thinking.
Bahasa Indonesia: refleks
Example: Your eye blinks by reflex when dust blows near it.
cards.say: reflex. A quick movement your body makes without thinking. Your eye blinks by reflex when dust blows near it.

cards.back:
Treatment to help someone get better, often without medicine.
Bahasa Indonesia: terapi
Example: Swimming therapy helped him strengthen his injured leg.
cards.say: therapy. Treatment to help someone get better, often without medicine. Swimming therapy helped him strengthen his injured leg.

cards.back:
Care and exercise to help someone recover after illness.
Bahasa Indonesia: rehabilitasi
Example: Rehabilitation helped her walk again after the operation.
cards.say: rehabilitation. Care and exercise to help someone recover after illness. Rehabilitation helped her walk again after the operation.

cards.back:
Able to recover quickly after trouble.
Bahasa Indonesia: tangguh
Example: Resilient children learn from mistakes and try again.
cards.say: resilient. Able to recover quickly after trouble. Resilient children learn from mistakes and try again.

cards.back:
Eating the right amounts of different kinds of food.
Bahasa Indonesia: pola makan seimbang
Example: A balanced diet includes fruit, vegetables, protein and grains.
cards.say: balanced diet. Eating the right amounts of different kinds of food. A balanced diet includes fruit, vegetables, protein and grains.
